app.name: Aroom
start.intro.title: Count your days together
start.intro.f1: Counts D+Day from the day you got together
start.intro.f2: Reminds you of 50 days, 100 days, anniversaries and birthdays
start.intro.f3: See it on your Home Screen and Lock Screen
start.intro.terms: By continuing, you agree to the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.
onb.age: You must be 14 or older to use $t(app.name).
start.choose.title: How would you like to start?
start.choose.new.title: Start fresh
start.choose.new.body: Enter your start date and invite your partner
start.choose.join.title: I have an invite code
start.choose.join.body: Enter the 8-character code from your partner
start.date.title: When did you two start dating?
start.date.body: This day counts as Day 1. You can change it later in Settings.
start.date.label: Start date
start.date.err.future: You can't pick a date after today.
start.profile.title: Tell us about you
start.profile.name: Your name
start.profile.birthdayHint: Once you both add your birthdays, they show up in each other's anniversaries. Uses the Gregorian (solar) calendar.
start.profile.err.name: Please enter your name
invite.title: Invite your partner
invite.body: Send this code to your partner. It works once and expires in 24 hours.
invite.label: Invite code

join.title: Enter your invite code
join.body: Enter the 8-character code your partner sent you.
join.found.title: Join this space?
start.join.found.body: You started dating on {date}. Today is Day {n}.
start.connected.title: You're connected!
notify.pre.title: Want a reminder so you never miss a day?
notify.pre.body: We'll remind you at 9:00 AM on the day. You can change the time and early reminders in Settings.
notify.sample.body: Today is Pepero Day. $t(mascot.name) is celebrating with you.
notify.os.title: "$t(app.name)" Would Like to Send You Notifications
notify.os.label: iOS system prompt
notify.os.body: We'll remind you on your special days.
home.next.label: Next up
home.upcoming.title: Coming up
home.today.title: Today is our {title}
home.today.body.season: $t(mascot.name) is celebrating your day with you.
home.today.late: {date} was your {title}. $t(mascot.name) is celebrating a little late.
home.pending.title: You'll connect when your partner enters the code
home.pending.hint: Once connected, your partner's birthday and your custom days show up too.
invite.expired.title: This code has expired
invite.expired.body: Create a new code and send it to your partner.
state.error.title: Couldn't load

state.offline.readonly: You can edit again once you are online
state.offline.empty.title: Nothing loaded yet
state.offline.empty.body: We'll show it as soon as you're online.
state.ended.body: Your shared space has ended. Your dates and anniversaries are no longer available.
end.done.title: Space ended
anniv.birthday.wait: {name}'s birthday shows up once they add it
anniv.birthday.mine: Add your birthday so you can both see it
anniv.empty.title: Add a day that is just yours
anniv.empty.body: Save days that matter to you two, like the day you met or your first trip. Your partner sees them too.
anniv.rule.years: Every year on your start date ({md})
anniv.detail.system.note: Automatic days can't be edited or deleted. Change reminders by type in Settings.
anniv.detail.birthday.note: Only the birthday person can change it.
set.me.edit.title: Edit my info
anniv.detail.preset.auto: Added automatically as a couple day. If you delete it, it won't come back.
edit.new.title: New anniversary
edit.edit.title: Edit anniversary
edit.field.title: Title
edit.preview.past: This date has passed, so it'll go under Past.
edit.err.title.long: Titles can be up to 20 characters
edit.err.memo.long: Notes can be up to 100 characters
edit.shared.hint: Once saved, {name} sees it too. If {name}'s app is closed, their phone updates when they open it.
edit.shared.hint.unpaired: Your partner will see it too once you connect.
edit.delete.title: Delete this anniversary?
edit.delete.body: It'll disappear for {name} too, and this can't be undone.
edit.conflict.title: {name} edited this first
edit.conflict.body: We loaded the latest version. Check it and save again.
edit.gone.title: This anniversary was already deleted
edit.gone.body: {name} deleted it. We'll take you back to the list.
edit.discard.title: Discard your changes?
edit.save.err: Couldn't save. Your changes are still here.
edit.presets.title: Fun days to add
widget.gallery.dday.name: D+Day
widget.gallery.dday.desc: Shows your days together and what is coming up.
widget.gallery.list.name: Coming up
widget.gallery.list.desc: Shows your upcoming anniversaries in order.
widget.pending.body: Send the invite code from the app
widget.none.title: Start $t(app.name)

set.title: Settings
set.me.name: Name
set.me.birthday.partnerWait: {name} hasn't added a birthday yet. Once you both do, you'll see each other's.
set.us.tz.note: Midnight and reminder times follow this time zone, for both of you.
set.start.title: Change start date
set.start.preview: After the change, today will be Day {n}
set.start.confirm.title: Change your start date?
set.start.confirm.body: {old} → {new}. {name}'s screen, widgets and milestone dates change too.
set.notify.note: Reminders ring on this device only; {name} sets their own. Up to 50 upcoming days are scheduled on this device, and changes {name} makes are picked up when you open the app.
set.notify.denied.title: Notifications are off on this device
set.notify.denied.body: Turn on $t(app.name) notifications in your device settings to get reminders.
notify.body.custom: You have a special day today
notify.title: $t(app.name)
set.security.title: Sign-in & security
set.logout.title: Sign out?
set.disconnect.title: Disconnect?
set.disconnect.i1: Your shared space ends. {name} can't see it anymore either.
set.disconnect.i2: Your start date, custom anniversaries and shared birthdays are deleted.
set.disconnect.i3: This can't be undone. To use it again, you'll need to connect anew.
set.disconnect.i4: Widgets and reminders on this device are cleared too.
set.delete.title: Delete your account?
set.delete.body: You'll be signed out right away, and this can't be undone.
set.delete.i1: Your account and profile information are deleted
set.delete.i2: If you share a space, it ends. Neither of you can open it, and your dates and anniversaries are deleted
set.delete.i3: Signing up again with the same login won't bring anything back
set.delete.reauth: Sign in again with {provider} to confirm
set.delete.apple.note: For accounts created with Apple, the Apple connection is also removed when you delete.
login.email.label: Email
login.pw.label: Password
login.signup.link: New here? Create an account with a password
auth.login.wrong: That email or password isn't right. Please check and try again.
auth.login.rate: Too many wrong attempts. Please try again in 10 minutes.
auth.login.rate.apple: If you signed up with Apple, you can sign in with Apple now.
login.signup.title: Create your account
login.signup.terms: I agree to the Terms and Privacy Policy (14 or older)
auth.pw.stored: We never store your password as typed. It's kept only in a form no one can read.
login.signup.sent.title: We sent a confirmation email
login.signup.sent.body: Tap the link in the email we sent to {email} to finish signing up.
login.mail.spam: If it doesn't arrive, check your spam folder or resend in a minute.
auth.signup.nomail.title: You can't sign up with email just yet
auth.signup.nomail.body: We can't send confirmation emails yet. Continue with Apple to start right away.
login.reset.title: Let's reset your password
login.reset.body: We'll send a reset link to your sign-up email.
auth.reset.apple: Signed up with Apple? Sign in with Apple, then make a new one in Settings › Sign-in & security. No email needed.
login.reset.sent.title: Reset email sent
login.reset.sent.body: If that email has an account, we sent a link to {email}. Tap it to create a new password.
auth.reset.nomail.title: We can't send reset emails yet
auth.reset.nomail.body: We're still setting up email. Your current password hasn't changed.
auth.reset.nomail.apple.title: Signed up with Apple?
auth.reset.nomail.apple.body: Sign in with Apple, then make a new password in Settings.
auth.reset.nomail.email.title: Signed up with email?
auth.reset.nomail.email.body: Contact us at the address below and we'll help once we've confirmed it's you.
login.pw.new.title: Create a new password
login.pw.new.body: Next time, you can sign in right away with this password.
auth.link.exp.title: This link can't be used
auth.link.exp.body: It expired or was already used. Please request a new reset email.
auth.link.confirmExp.title: This confirmation link can't be used
auth.link.confirmExp.body: The link has expired or was already used. Get a new confirmation email.
auth.setpw.prompt.title: Want to add a password too?
auth.setpw.prompt.body: You can keep using Apple without one. Here's what it adds.
auth.setpw.prompt.b1: You can also sign in with email and password
auth.setpw.prompt.b2: You can confirm important actions, like deleting your account, with it
auth.setpw.prompt.note: This is a new password just for $t(app.name), separate from your Apple Account password, which never reaches the app.
auth.setpw.later.note: You can make one later in Settings › Sign-in & security.
onb.pw.title: Create an app password
onb.pw.body: You'll use this to sign in with email and to confirm account deletion. It's separate from your Apple Account password.
auth.setpw.done.title: App password created
auth.setpw.done.body: You can now sign in with Apple, or with email and password.
set.security.relay: This is the private address Apple made for you. Enter it exactly to sign in with email.
auth.setpw.done.again: You can find it again anytime in Settings › Sign-in & security.
auth.setpw.sheet.body: You can keep using Apple as you do now. With a password, you can also sign in with email and confirm account deletion with it.
auth.save.err.title: Couldn't save
auth.save.err.body: Please try again in a moment.
auth.send.err.title: Couldn't send the email
auth.send.err.body: Please try again in a moment.
set.security.pwNote: You use your app password to sign in with email and before important actions like deleting your account.
acct.delete.reauth.forgot.title: Can't remember your password?
set.pw.forgot.body: Sign in with Apple again to make a new one without your current password. No email needed.
acct.delete.reauth.forgot.oauth: Confirm by signing in with Apple
set.security.noneNote: You don't need it to sign in with Apple. With one, you can also sign in with email and confirm account deletion with it.
set.pw.wrong: Your current password isn't right. Please try again.
acct.delete.reauth.title: Please confirm it's you
acct.delete.reauth.body: To protect your account, enter your app password.
acct.delete.reauth.apple: For accounts created with Apple, the Apple connection is also removed when you delete.
acct.delete.reauth.wrong: That password isn't right. Please try again.
acct.delete.reauth.rate: Too many wrong attempts. Try again in 10 minutes, or confirm by signing in with Apple.
acct.delete.reauth.forgot.body: You can confirm by signing in with Apple again. No email needed.
acct.delete.apple.more.title: One more Apple check
acct.delete.apple.more.body: Your password was right. To remove the Apple connection too, please confirm once more on the Apple screen.
acct.delete.reauth.body.email: To protect your account, enter your password.
acct.delete.reauth.forgot.mail: Get a reset email, make a new password, then try deleting again.
acct.delete.reauth.forgot.nomail: We can't send reset emails yet. Contact us and we'll delete your account once we've confirmed it's you.
home.pending.haveCode: I got a code from my partner
connect.title: Connect with your partner
connect.body: One of you sends a code and the other enters it to connect.
connect.send.title: Send my invite code
connect.send.body: Your partner enters it and joins your space
connect.enter.title: Enter a code I got
connect.enter.body: Join your partner's space with their 8-character code
connect.note: Joining with a code closes your current space. You'll share your partner's start date and anniversaries.
connect.code.title: Enter your partner's code
connect.code.body: Enter the 8-character code from your partner to move into their space and connect.
connect.move.title: Move to your partner's space?
connect.move.i1: Your current space closes, and the invite code you made stops working.
connect.move.i2: You'll share your partner's start date and anniversaries. Custom days you added in your space don't move over.
connect.move.i3: Your name and birthday stay the same.
connect.err.own: That's your own code. Send it to your partner instead.
join.hasSpace.body.v0: You can only be in one space at a time. End your current space first in Settings › Disconnect, then enter the code again.
update.title: A new version is out
update.body: Update to version {version} on the App Store to get the latest features and fixes.
